safety.text: She says she has supported sheriff resources and other public safety investments and will back law enforcement.
safety.quote: She has supported sheriff resources, K-9 units, emergency communications upgrades, and investments in public safety infrastructure.

immigration.text: She supports border security and enforcing immigration law.
immigration.quote: She supports President Trump’s commitment to border security and enforcing immigration law.

guns.text: She says she has testified against gun control laws and opposes restrictions on lawful gun owners.
guns.quote: As a county commissioner, Amanda has testified against gun control laws that punish responsible citizens, impose financial barriers on working families, and fail to stop criminals.

abortion.text: She says all life should be protected from conception.
abortion.quote: I believe that all life has meaning and value and must be protected from conception.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: She supports reserving women’s sports for biological females.
gender.quote: She supports protecting Title IX and ensuring that women’s sports remain for biological females.

energy.text: She opposes energy mandates she says would raise costs and supports affordable, reliable domestic energy.
energy.quote: She opposes radical energy mandates that raise costs, destabilize the grid, and hurt farmers, families, and small businesses.

wages.text: His campaign says he would raise the federal minimum wage and protect workers’ right to organize.
wages.quote: Raise the federal minimum wage so work actually pays

trade.text: He called for removing tariffs and restoring normal trade relations with U.S. partners.
trade.quote: get the tariffs gone and start building back our normal trade relations with our partners and being a reliable trade partner in the world.

debt.text: He said Social Security should be protected and restored rather than cut or privatized.
debt.quote: It is not an optional talking point to protect Social Security. It is a moral imperative.

health.text: His campaign supports expanding ACA subsidies, protecting Medicare and Medicaid, and moving toward universal health care.
health.quote: Move toward universal healthcare access so coverage doesn't depend on your employer or your ZIP code
